Both directions use same0.5 scale and actor reflection about projected ground anchor; never mirror the96x64 canvas. Wings/mantle chains physically folded, weapons held close/vertical.
adventure_map.attack_source_preservation: OriginalV8 battle scenes, battle/portrait/projectile recipes and PNGs, all old prepared map/attack PNGs, and projectile ledger unchanged. Prior42 map/attack recipes and112 source PNGs preserved with SHA receipt before selection.

calibration: Measure exactly one holding-frame alpha8 bounding box per variant. Use its fixed uniform scale and projected world origin across every action; never re-fit each frame.
compiler_status_explanation: painted-master-complete-unapproved is the existing compiler's technical bitmap-cohort enum. It means available rendered PNG sources in this workflow, not a claim that poses were hand-painted or artistically approved.
identity_limits: All seven generic lines are project adaptation; no unique champion is reproduced as an ordinary stack.
Windborne/Galecrest are a fictional local living winged vastayan community, not Rakan copies and not a claim that all Lhotlan possess this anatomy.

Spirit Wardens are original opaque masked ceremonial guardians in layered robes; retired bark/log subjects remain history. They are not translucent ghosts, bare-chested turbaned Genies, Demacian petricite constructs or a copied Riot champion/skin.
known_review_work: Low polygon candidate geometry and shader material detail still require final native Heroes III artistic review.
Ordinary monster adventure animations require only native group0; actual map rendering and artistic acceptance remain pending.
Native all-action elapsed playback, missile launch synchronization, death position, flying landing, casting and upgrade comparison remain pending.
Generated bitmap completeness does not establish artistic, gameplay, rights or release acceptance.

lor_subject_revision.mechanics: No combat statistics, ammunition, flight, spells, action costs or abilities changed. Native pivots/calibration and actual hand release transforms preserved.
lor_subject_revision.other_families: Distinct teal/ivory staff trainees, navy/teal masked Kinkou, navy/ivory/rose ceremonial Monks and practical red/navy Resistance. New cross-collar, robe, sleeve, mask and mantle geometry accompany palette changes.
lor_subject_revision.reference_use: Eight exact official LoR full illustrations viewed privately for cloth, mask, feather, material and colour construction. URLs and SHA-256 recorded in model metadata; no illustration pixels are textures, frames or portrait crops.

subjects.bow: Original short-fox-eared humaniform local archers, no antlers/deer muzzle. Physical recurve and quiver, layered cross-collar robes, teal travel wrap or upgraded ivory lacquer halfmask/dusky-rose tabard/navy undersleeve.
subjects.warden: Original opaque masked biped ceremonial spirits with indigo/ivory robes, curved engraved ivory mask, turquoise trim and dusky-rose mantle. Elder adds broad layered mantle, raised etched bronze crest and blossom reliquaries; prior log forms retired.
subjects.wing: Original humaniform living featherfolk with small pointed ears and bound dark hair; ivory/pale-blue/dusky-rose layered feathers, Ionian robe panels and lacquered upgrade protection. No horned woodland body.

changes: Original painted material atlas combined with broad procedural value wear and cloth bump folds that remain visible after native reduction.
Real stitched limb seams, robe-fold ridges, grip fingers, brow/eye/mouth planes, armor rims, weapon bevel lines and carved bark/face recess geometry.
Living Kin use curved tapered feather meshes with raised vanes, narrow quills, barb lines and overlapping shorter coverts; original wing bones and flight action semantics retained.
material_detail_revision.framing: Use exactly the prior native-to-world scale and ground pivot. Raw resolution changes sampling, so individual alpha-edge differences are measured rather than described as unchanged pixels.
material_detail_revision.projectile_release: Saved old/new Blender joint matrices, cameras and actual native projections compared at all twelve g14/15/16 frame003 cases; measured ledger points and content offsets remain unchanged.
material_detail_revision.quality_limit: The underlying rigid segmented anatomy and generic head/hand volumes remain simple. This bounded material/detail pass does not supply final sculpted anatomy or a bespoke painted finish for every pose. Further native artistic review and refinement remain required.
material_detail_revision.scope: All fourteen existing subjects and keyed action families; earlier source revisions and pre-pass recipe selections preserved.

source_method: Original editable volumetric Blender meshes, articulated rigid joints and keyed physical poses; original built-in imagegen painted material atlas. Rendered bitmap poses are not painted pose-atlas generation, idle-image warps, or borrowed original creature frames.

spirit_blossom_direction.interpretation: Original generic troop ceremonial accents inspired by Ionia festival folklore; no canonical champion skin identity, moral classification, ghost transformation or combat statistic change.
spirit_blossom_direction.palette: Matte faded sky blue, warm ivory and dusty petal pink ties, small carved remembrance charms and branch blossoms; existing indigo, purple, bark, jade and practical red equipment identities remain.
spirit_blossom_direction.verification: New cohort source hashes, exact stock preview crop, action frame differences and configured compiler plan are reviewed separately from native gameplay or artistic approval.
